Speaking at a reception for Jewish athletes in Berlin, Merz said: 
This historical responsibility of our country applies just as much to those who come here to Germany from Islamic countries. 
And anyone who fails to abide by this must leave our country.

Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez:
The other day, Milei, the president of Argentina, came here to say that socialism is fascism.
We will not allow Milei to define socialism, because socialism was defined, for example, by a great Catalan like Ernest Lluch when he helped build public healthcare in our country.
The history of socialism is full of men and women who suffered repression, exile, death and imprisonment for defending democracy.
Those who are the descendants of his friends, those who stood on their side in the past, were the ones who destroyed democracy in our country. That is the great difference.

Key proposals include:
Renegotiate EU treaties.
Support the creation of a Palestinian state alongside Israel.
Gradually withdraw from NATO's integrated military command.
Lower the retirement age from 64 to 60.
Gradually introduce a 32-hour workweek.
Allow three days of sick leave without a doctor's note.
Introduce nine months of mandatory paid environmental service for under-25s.
Make healthcare fully covered by social security.
Freeze prices of essential goods.
Restore the wealth tax and introduce a billionaire tax.
